name: Zengwun Dam
location: No. 70, Nanxi Village, Nansi District, Tainan City, Taiwan
description: Zengwun Dam is one of Taiwan’s largest reservoirs, serving irrigation, water supply, and flood control. The surrounding area is scenic with mountain views.

name: Wu Shan Tou Reservoir
location: No. 68-2, Jianan Village, Guantian District, Tainan City, Taiwan 720
description: Wushantou Reservoir, also known as Coral Lake, is a historic reservoir designed by engineer Yoichi Hatta. It is known for calm water scenery, walking trails, and recreation areas.

name: Tsou-Ma-Lai Farm
description: Tsou-Ma-Lai Farm is a large recreational farm featuring open grasslands, camping areas, fruit orchards, animal zones, and seasonal outdoor activities.

name: Leopard King Safari Zoo
location: No. 75-25, San Qing Village, Xuejia District, Tainan City, Taiwan 726
description: Leopard King Safari Zoo, also called Wanpi World Safari Zoo, is a popular family attraction with a wide range of animals, interactive areas, and ecological exhibits.

name: Chimei Museum
location: No. 66, Section 2, Wenhua Road, Rende District, Tainan City 71755, Taiwan
description: Chimei Museum is known for its extensive collections including Western art, musical instruments, natural history specimens, and one of the world’s largest violin collections.

name: Daitianfu Temple, Madou
location: No. 60, Guandi Village, Madou District, Tainan City, Taiwan
description: Madou Daitianfu Temple is a large Taoist temple notable for its grand architecture, dragon tunnel walkway, and a unique underground ‘Heaven and Hell’ attraction.

name: Chikan Tower
location: No. 201, Wufei Street, West Central District, Tainan City, Taiwan
description: Chikan Tower, originally Fort Provintia built by the Dutch in 1653, is a historic landmark known for its classical architecture, courtyards, and cultural exhibits.

name: Confucius Temple
location: No. 2, Nanmen Road, West Central District, Tainan City, Taiwan
description: The Tainan Confucius Temple is one of the oldest Confucian temples in Taiwan, featuring traditional courtyards, preserved historic halls, and cultural events.

name: War God Temple
location: 229, Section 2, Yongfu Road, West Central District, Tainan City 700, Taiwan
description: The War God Temple is dedicated to the historical figure Guan Yu. It is known for its colorful decorations, wooden carvings, and long-standing cultural importance.

name: Anping Recreation Area
description: The Anping Recreation Area includes seafront parks, historic streets, coastal scenery, and major attractions such as Anping Old Street and historic forts.
